time_range: Per-trade snapshot_time in (recorded exit, exchange regular close], all times timezone aware. snapshot_time collector start-of-pass, not event or availability time. Exact-symbol three-leg source rows; no price-quality filter during extraction.
normalization: Group by trade ID and snapshot_time, exactly one of each verified symbol, correct strike/root/expiration/direction/underlying, finite nonnegative leg bid/ask/mark and ask>=bid. Reject/report duplicate keys and incomplete/invalid groups; preserve raw rows. Do not clip negative composite prices or replace provider marks with midpoint.
inventory_reconciliation: Recompute historical inventory predicate separately: exactly three rows, distinct strikes=3, expiration/type match, bid>=0, ask>=bid, mark IS NOT NULL. Compare count/first/last at microsecond precision; differences remain discrepancies.
minute_buckets: UTC floor-to-minute (equivalent to ET grid for these sessions). Full expected buckets start at ceil(exit) and end strictly before close; partial exit minute and exact-close boundary are separate. Never impute missing buckets. p95 uses nearest rank.

eligibility.import_eligible: Any available raw rows retained; per-group normalization eligibility recorded. No strategy eligibility inferred.
eligibility.reason: Minute sampling has different semantics; no causal minute signal/fill/gap/freshness policy registered. Missing event/availability evidence not inferred.

scope_exclusions: No P&L, signals, hold-after-exit rules, parameter search or liquidity threshold selection
retention: Accepted Eros; independent backup not established
